MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

5. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

6. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.

7. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

8. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
